description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Thief], [ATK +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Wind/Poison abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, penetrate 20% DEF and RES; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single piercing attack (11.00) capped at 199,999. Grants [Wind, Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Wind, Poison DEF and RES 40% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Wind, Poison Damage Cap +30000 (Tactical)], [Wind, Poison Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)] to user if Level 2+ EnWind or EnPoison, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Wind, Poison Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Wind or Poison attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Wind, Poison DEF and RES 40% Piercing (Tactical)
description.text: Wind and Poison abilities ignore 40% of the target's DEF and RES, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Wind, Poison Damage Cap +30000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Wind or Poison attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Wind, Poison Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Wind or Poison abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Poison 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
